findings.explanation: mirror moon again treats 新都 as the Shinto religion or place name rather than Fuyuki’s New City.

findings.highlight: We have to find Lancer’s Master
findings.governingReading: as soon as even one day sooner
findings.explanation: The urgency of identifying the remaining Master disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 未だ見ぬマスター……ランサーのマスター
findings.governingReading: the Master he has not yet seen—Lancer’s Master
findings.explanation: Shirou’s lack of identification and encounter history is omitted.

findings.governingReading: the same as the day before yesterday
findings.explanation: The patrol policy is moved forward by one day.

findings.governingReading: pretend indifference until sensing the enemy
findings.explanation: Their tactical performance of not noticing danger becomes generic civilian disguise.

findings.evidenceJa: これといった手応えはなかった
findings.governingReading: they obtained no notable response or useful lead
findings.explanation: A lack of actionable signs becomes a claim that nothing at all was found.

findings.evidenceJa: 細かな変化は感じ取れない
findings.governingReading: he cannot perceive the subtle changes
findings.explanation: Plural, fine-grained changes become one generic change.

findings.highlight: I don’t feel any magical energy that stands out
findings.evidenceJa: 目立った魔力の残滓もなく
findings.governingReading: there is no conspicuous residue of magical energy
findings.explanation: A residual trace becomes currently present energy.

findings.highlight: there must be no Masters in Shinto
findings.evidenceJa: 新都に潜むマスターはいないようなのだが
findings.governingReading: it seems there may be no Master hiding in New City, but
findings.explanation: Shirou’s hedged and unsettled impression becomes confident necessity and loses the adversative hesitation.

findings.evidenceJa: こんなに人気がなかったかな
findings.governingReading: whether the station area was always this devoid of people
findings.explanation: A concrete question about human presence becomes a broader atmospheric judgment.

findings.highlight: we should go home for tonight
findings.evidenceJa: 今夜は大人しく引き上げましょう
findings.governingReading: they should withdraw quietly and behave themselves tonight
findings.explanation: Saber’s restrained tactical withdrawal becomes only a destination.

findings.evidenceJa: 人気のないターミナル
findings.explanation: The broader terminal setting is narrowed to a station.

findings.evidenceJa: 乾いた足音だけが響いていった
findings.governingReading: only dry footsteps continue to echo
findings.explanation: The dry sound and its isolation in the empty terminal disappear.
